email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Communication and Project Assistant (Trainee) position at LLLP. With a background in digital marketing, SEO and content, and hands-on experience in EU-funded project communication, I am eager to contribute to your mission of promoting lifelong learning.

In my current roles, I draft content for external channels, design graphics with Canva, and manage CMS platforms like WordPress. I have supported dissemination strategies for EU projects, liaising with partners and creating communication templates. My digital skills include social media management, newsletter tools, and analytics. I am fluent in English and have a keen interest in EU policy, particularly in education and training.

I thrive in multicultural teams and am committed to learning and delivering high-quality work under tight deadlines. I would welcome the opportunity to bring my communication and project support skills to LLLP.

Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Communication and Project Assistant (Trainee) role at the Lifelong Learning Platform. Your commitment to promoting lifelong learning across Europe resonates deeply with my professional interests and my background in digital communication and project support.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I have gained practical experience in drafting content for external communication channels, including newsletters, web articles, and social media. I have designed graphic materials using Canva and managed content through WordPress and other CMS platforms. My work on EU-funded projects has involved supporting dissemination strategies, liaising with project partners, and creating communication templates for reports and publications. For instance, I have contributed to the communication efforts of projects by ensuring consistent messaging and timely delivery of content.

I possess strong digital skills and media literacy, and I am fluent in English. I have a keen interest in EU policy and initiatives, particularly in the field of education and lifelong learning. My ability to adapt language to different audiences and my experience with tools like Brevo and Mailchimp (or similar) enable me to craft effective communication materials. I am also familiar with Erasmus+ funding programmes through my work on related projects.

I am a team player who thrives in multicultural environments and is eager to learn continuously. I am confident that my flexibility and willingness to engage in lifelong learning make me a strong fit for this trainee position. I am enthusiastic about the opportunity to contribute to LLLP's communication and project activities and to grow professionally within your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can support your work.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
